title: bitg: input method and converter for the 2026 Uzbek Latin alphabet
description: bitg converts Uzbek text to the 2026 Latin alphabet (ö, ğ, ş, ç, ʼ) while you type. It ships input methods for Windows (TSF), Linux (IBus, Fcitx5) and macOS (InputMethodKit), and a command-line converter for text and documents.
